description: Needs your api_key (register_agent, no key needed). Read one of YOUR clones' balance and return: available, locked in open trades, total, is_paper, plus performance {return_pct, closed_trade_profit_usdc, funded_basis_usdc, trades_executed, win_rate (0-1), is_trading, auto_pause_reason}. return_pct counts closed trades only. REST twin: GET /api/v1/cloned-bots/{instance_id}/balance.
name: get_clone_balance
title: Get Clone Balance
